title: Music Theory for Programmers
why_read: A cross-disciplinary explainer connecting music theory concepts to programming concepts, useful for a broad technical audience.
analysis: This is likely an educational article mapping musical structures (scales, harmony, rhythm) onto programming/CS concepts to make music theory more approachable for engineers. Such analogies can be genuinely illuminating for engineers who want to understand music from a systems perspective, though the depth depends heavily on execution. It's a popular explainer style piece rather than groundbreaking research.
